text_blocks.content: You enter the sacred circle where the elder druids gather around a dying fire. Eira, the most senior druid, steps forward. 'The Veil grows stronger,' she says, her voice heavy with worry. 'Our wards will not hold for much longer. We must make a choice—reinforce the barriers at great cost to ourselves, or send a small group beyond the Grove to find the source of The Veil's power.' The decision falls to you.
